name: @maronn-openid-connect/sample-fastify-flyio
description: Fastify sample app with OpenID Provider code generated by the CLI

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @maronn-openid-connect/core --filter @maronn-openid-connect/experimental run build && tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --external:fastify --outfile=dist/server.js --sourcemap
scripts.launch: pnpm run build && pnpm run start
